Nora V: Heads up — cut blocked. `release-runner` failing at artifact index step during promote, 3/3 failures. Change window closes in 50m.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for run 2026-03-27T15:00Z. Failing checks: artifact-index. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/40001
Hector M: seeing `lease acquire` errors from artifact-indexer: `E_CONFLICT: lease already held (id=abc123)` after a recent replica bump. Could be a race between two indexer instances.
Nora V: options: 1) fast patch — force a single-indexer run by adding `--single-run` flag and re-promote (quick), 2) pin to previous RC artifact index and promote (very quick), 3) abort cut for full investigation (delays + change window miss).
Hector M: single-run flag is low-risk and reversible. I'll open a tiny PR and trigger manual promote. If anything odd in canary, we revert.
SRE_Oncall: if we go with single-run, I'll monitor indexer metric `indexer.leases.conflicts` and set a high-fidelity alert to page if >2 in 10m during rollout.
Nora V: agreed — prefer single-run over pin to avoid stale index. Patch + promote, then watch canary for indexing mismatches.
Hector M: PR created: `ci: indexer --single-run during promote to avoid lease contention` on branch `rc/indexer-single-1701000000`. Merged and triggering manual promote.
deploy-bot: Manual promote triggered by Hector M. CI run id 40002 queued.
QA_Bot: smoke checks: artifact-index integrity step will validate manifests post-index. Running validation.
deploy-bot: CI run 40002 artifact-index: 2/2 passed. Promotion allowed. :white_check_mark:
Nora V: cutting RC now. Release notes draft: "RC 2026.03.27 — temporary single-run indexer flag applied to avoid lease conflicts during promote; follow-up ticket #6100." Will include link to PR and CI run id.
Hector M: creating ticket #6100 with logs, race hypothesis, and plan to add a leader-election/coordination fix for long-term.
SRE_Oncall: monitor in place. If we observe any manifest drift or missing layers in canary, we'll immediately rollback and run a coordinated reindex.
Nora V: thanks team. If #6100 shows a deeper orchestrator bug we'll schedule a patch release outside the change window and update stakeholders.
